resources.string: In use. The desktop follows this window.

Start a separate desktop that fits this window and follows window size changes. Reconnects for this session only; saved settings are unchanged. Uses the window\'s orientation instead of a saved orientation lock. Support depends on the remote device.
A display choice reconnects this session only, replacing any camera or virtual desktop. Saved settings are unchanged.
Return to the main screen first. This desktop\'s temporary display disappears on reconnect; other displays can be selected afterwards.
Auto-fit is paused while recording. The latest window size will be applied after recording stops.
The desktop is still resizing. Start recording after the new picture arrives.
Stop recording before switching displays or starting an adaptive desktop.
The desktop resize was not confirmed. New recordings are blocked for safety. Use Restart desktop in Display to reconnect and retry.
The window has not been measured yet. Try starting the desktop again.
Connect to the device before choosing a display.
That display ID is outside the supported range.
Saving the recording. Wait for the copy to finish.
